name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.2-beta+7

- LG TVs: play on the TV's own player (MKV included) without DLNA
  - LG TVs ignore the DLNA search from iPhone, so AnymeX+ now talks to them the way LG's phone app does: the TV shows up in Cast to Device as an LG TV, asks once to "Allow" the phone, then plays the video in its own player (MKV included).
  - Remote in the Cast sheet: play/pause, rewind, fast forward, stop. The TV starts from the beginning (seek with the TV remote).
  - "Add it by IP address" now also accepts LG TVs.
